svg.text: Entity relationship diagram (25 tables, crow's foot notation)
Not drawn, to keep the lines readable: domains and project_types are also referenced by idea_checks, problem_bank and idea_suggestions;
tags by problem_tags; users by match_overrides. UQ* = part of a composite unique key: (group_code, semester_id) and (fingerprint, corpus_project_id).
Bottom row: corpus_project_topics.project_id refers to corpus_projects; problem_topics and problem_twist refer to problem_bank; suggestion_proof refers to idea_suggestions.
